column3: “The sanctuary, the stronghold” is rendered “the sanctuary fortress”; “the perpetual” is rendered “the regular sacrifice,” and “the abomination desolating” “the abomination of desolation.”
“He will pollute” is rendered “he will turn to godlessness.”
“Stumble” is rendered “fall,” and “intrigues” “hypocrisy”; the active “helped” becomes “granted.”
“Stumble” is rendered “fall,” and “the time of the end” “the end time.”
“Pay attention” is rendered “show regard”; NASB adds “other.”
“The fortresses of strongholds” is rendered “the strongest of fortresses”; NASB adds “with the help of.”
NASB supplies “countries” after “many” and renders “the first” as “the foremost.”
NASB supplies “other”; “not become an escaped remnant” is rendered “will not escape.”
“Treasures” is rendered “hidden treasures,” “Cushites” “Ethiopians,” and “in his footsteps” “follow at his heels.”
“The mountain of the beauty of holiness” is rendered “the beautiful Holy Mountain,” and “his palace” “his royal pavilion.”
